newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to clear France's plan to support Corsica.
newsitem.headline: EU to clear France's plan to support Corsica.

text.p: The European Commission is to clear a French plan on Wednesday to grant Corsica a series of tax breaks to help boost the economy of the Mediterranean island plagued by decades of separatist violence.
"The scheme will be okayed," a source said on Friday.
The French government said in July that it wanted to create a tax-free zone in Corsica, by way of exempting from corporation and income tax mainly small businesses.
Territorial Minister Jean-Claude Gaudin said at the time the aid would be worth 600 million francs ($115.8 million) a year for five years.

Commission sources said that after an exchange of letters with Paris, the Commission did not appear to have any problems with the scheme. It should be nodded through at the Commission's weekly meeting without discussion. They gave no details. ($1=5.179 French Franc)
